probe.name: hmm-keystat-change
probe.rationale: Changes the scientific key statistics of the profile HMM while preserving line count, structural field counts and every model-body line: NSEQ 13→12, CKSUM→fake value, STATS LOCAL MSV intercept perturbed. The decoded Plan7 model therefore differs from the reference in NSEQ/CKSUM/MSV calibration, which check 2 requires to match exactly (no tolerance). The native HMM reader still parses the file and finds exactly one model (verified locally with pyhmmer.plan7.HMMFile), so the failure is scientific, not a cascading parse failure.
probe.script:
import os

ROOT = os.environ.get("PROBE_ROOT", "/case/submission")
PATH = os.path.join(ROOT, "LuxC.hmm")

with open(PATH, "r") as fh:
    text = fh.read()
lines = text.splitlines()
nseq = cksum = msv = 0
out = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("NSEQ  ") and not nseq:
        line = "NSEQ  12"; nseq = 1
    elif line.startswith("CKSUM "):
        line = "CKSUM 123456789"; cksum = 1
    elif line.startswith("STATS LOCAL MSV"):
        line = "STATS LOCAL MSV      -11.5000  0.69925"; msv = 1
    out.append(line)
assert nseq and cksum and msv, (nseq, cksum, msv)
assert lines.index("NSEQ  13") < lines.index("CKSUM 395769323")
new = "\n".join(out) + "\n"
assert "\n//" in new
tmp = PATH + ".probe_tmp"
with open(tmp, "w") as fh:
    fh.write(new)
os.replace(tmp, PATH)
print("mutated NSEQ/CKSUM/MSV lines in LuxC.hmm")
